qualityPolicy.introduction: The main goal of CetusPro Sp. z o.o. is to provide training services that meet the requirements and expectations of our Clients. The company's goal is also to strengthen its position as a leader in the training services market and to achieve financial results that enable continuous development.
guarantees: Maintaining and improving the quality system compliant with ISO 9001:2015 standard requirements
Continuous analysis of Client satisfaction measurement and anticipating their expectations
Full commitment of owners and employees to the joint implementation of quality policy and quality objectives
Educated and experienced staff who systematically improve their qualifications
Modern technical equipment enabling the use of latest technologies
Team cooperation atmosphere, individual responsibility of employees for quality and their identification
qualityPolicy.directionsDescription: The unchanging elements of our activity that determine development directions are:

Experience gained in the courses and training industry
Understanding and meeting the needs and expectations of current and future Clients
